steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Both Christianity and Islam teach that peace and justice are central to their faith. Reconciliation — restoring relationships after conflict — is a key religious duty. | RS Exam Tips — Peace, Justice and Reconciliation: 1. For Peace, Justice and Reconciliation questions, always include specific scriptural or source references where relevant 2. Explain both religious and non-religious viewpoints 3. Use specialist vocabulary precisely (e.g. terms from the specification) 4. Evaluate by analysing strengths and weaknesses of different views before reaching your conclusion 5. Link your discussion of Peace, Justice and Reconciliation to its real-world impact on believers and society | UK Context: In the UK, debates about often involve both religious and secular voices.
